injuries.name: Jalen Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson is questionable to suit up for Friday's game against Washington.

injuries.name: Keshon Gilbert
injuries.detail: Gilbert is out for Friday's game against the Wizards due to left knee inflammation.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.detail: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.detail: Newell (toe) is out for Friday's game against Washington.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Payton Pritchard
injuries.detail: Pritchard (eye) is questionable for Friday against Charlotte, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.detail: Carter (illness) practiced with the G League's Maine Celtics on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Moussa Diabate
injuries.detail: Diabate (quadriceps) is questionable for Friday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.detail: Schroder (thigh) is questionable for Friday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Peyton Watson
injuries.detail: Watson (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Jarrett Allen
injuries.detail: Allen (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.detail: Tyson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Tyrese Proctor
injuries.detail: Proctor (ankle) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.detail: Aldama (knee) is probable to suit up for Friday's game against the Jazz.

injuries.name: Max Christie
injuries.detail: Christie (hip) is probable for Friday's game against the Jazz.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Sandro Mamukelashvili
injuries.detail: Mamukelashvili (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.detail: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Kam Jones
injuries.detail: Jones (ankle/two-way player) is out for Friday's game against Toronto.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
injuries.detail: Shannon (hip) is questionable for Friday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Trey Murphy III
injuries.detail: Murphy (knee) is probable for Friday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.detail: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) is doubtful to play in Friday's game against the Cavaliers, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.detail: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.detail: Barnes (groin) is questionable to play Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Anthony Davis
injuries.detail: Davis is questionable for Friday's game against the Hawks due to a right ankle sprain, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.
